term: no infinite regress of causes of a perfection, accessibility (well-foundedness) reading
definition: `NoInfiniteRegressOfCausesOfAPerfectionReading CausesIn`: for every respect r, Lean core's `WellFounded` holds of `fun c x => c ≠ x ∧ CausesIn c x r`. Every being is accessible: each has a well-founded inductive certificate built from its distinct causes of r. This excludes infinite backward series and cycles of distinct causes of r, not self-causation, and bounds no finite depth.
note: The same accessibility reading the corpus gives the Second Way premise (DEF-REGRESS-ACCESSIBILITY-READING), applied to the cause-of-perfection relation DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION instead of per se efficient causes. Claim AQUINAS-IN-METAPH-II-L2-NO-INFINITE-CAUSES-OF-A-PERFECTION-A reads In Metaph. II lect. 2 n. 11 this way and records its reading step (a line indexed by perfection, not species of cause); sourcing the accessibility form itself would need a text denying a well-founded inductive certificate rather than only an infinite series.
